13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.visual_critic_note: Dark theme with intentional blue/orange source-target contrast and good fade-on-hover interaction, but at rest the dense edge hairball and tiny 10px labels make individual nodes difficult to read without hovering.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.encoding_integrity_note: Topological chart with no magnitude encoding violations; core bundle layout and tension formula (beta=1-tension) are correct, but the node--target CSS class is defined yet never applied in interaction code, leaving directional node coloring incomplete.
flags: Update Storm (slider input redraws all ~80 link paths on every tick without debounce or RAF)
Mouse-Touch Fight (hover uses only mouseenter/mouseleave with no touch equivalents)
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.stress_test_note: The tension slider triggers a full path recalculation and DOM update for all links on every input event without debouncing or requestAnimationFrame coalescing, but no brush, zoom, transitions, or cross-view dispatch patterns are present to trigger the remaining traps.
13-radial-dendrogram-edge-bundling.cognitive_load_note: 87 leaf nodes and ~80 bundled edges create a dense resting state, but high-tension bundling (0.85) imposes visible structure and the hover interaction—fading non-relevant edges to near-invisible while color-coding source/target in blue/orange—effectively converts the complexity into an on-demand lookup tool rather than a simultaneous perceptual burden.
